sn56.18:1.1: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn56.18:1.5: yaṃ kho bhikkhu dukkhe ñāṇaṃ dukkhasamudaye ñāṇaṃ dukkhanirodhe ñāṇaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ.
sn56.18:2.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhu idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yogo karaṇīyoti.
